items.t: Bitcoin falls below $56,000, its lowest since September 2024; $2.4 billion liquidated
items.x: Bitcoin slid to about $55,800 early on November 21, down almost 10% in a day, as the Wall Street sell-off hit crypto; $2.4 billion of positions were liquidated.

items.t: What's happening with Nvidia (NVDA)? Stock plunges 14% on reported SEC accounting probe
items.x: Nvidia closed down 14% at $125.53 on November 20 after Reuters reported the SEC is looking at its accounting. The stock is now about half its October high.

items.t: S&P 500 and Dow fall into correction as Nasdaq has its worst week since 2020
items.x: The S&P 500 fell 3.7% and the Nasdaq 5.3% on November 20, pushing the S&P 500 and the Dow into a correction. What happened and what it means for regular buyers.

items.t: Market wrap Nov 20: Nasdaq −5.3%, Nvidia −14% and Bitcoin below $60K
items.x: The AI sell-off hit everything on Friday. Nasdaq −5.3%, S&P 500 in a correction, Bitcoin under $60K, gold at a 14-month low. What moved and why.

items.t: Best Japanese stocks: 40 big names tested, Advantest +366% in 5 years

items.x: The Nasdaq lost 5.28% on 20 November and is now below where 2026 began. How far it is from the top, what past crashes did to DCA buyers and what $10 a day returned.

items.t: Bitcoin falls below $60,000 for the first time since July; $1.6 billion liquidated
items.x: Bitcoin slid under $60,000 on November 20 and touched about $59,000 as the AI stock sell-off spread to crypto. Ether lost 8%; liquidations hit $1.6 billion.

items.t: What's happening with Gap (GAP)? Shares jump 15% on a profit beat despite a cut outlook
items.x: Gap rose about 15% on November 20 after Q3 earnings of $0.82 a share beat the $0.78 estimate, even as it cut its yearly forecast on soft autumn demand.

items.t: What's happening with Micron (MU)? Shares plunge 13% as the memory-chip sell-off deepens
items.x: Micron fell about 13% to near $603 on November 20, half its June record, as AI chip stocks sank again and TrendForce warned NAND prices may fall in 2027.

items.t: Bitcoin miners sold nearly half their BTC reserves this year to fund AI data centers
items.x: Glassnode data shows six listed bitcoin miners, including MARA and Riot, have sold almost half their BTC since January to pay for AI and computing build-outs.

items.t: What's happening with NEAR Protocol (NEAR)? An 11% drop to $3 pushes it out of the top 20
items.x: NEAR fell about 10–12% in 24 hours to near $3.02 on November 20 as bitcoin broke below $62,000. We found no NEAR-specific news. What it means if you buy.

items.t: Nvidia heads for a seventh straight weekly loss, its longest losing streak since 2008
items.x: Nvidia fell about 4% before Friday's open and is down about 22% this year, while global stocks posted a seventh daily decline in a row on AI and rate worries.

items.t: Anthropic shares slip 6% premarket after a $97.17 first close; AI giants lost $496 billion
items.x: Anthropic closed its first day at $97.17, 17% above the IPO price, then fell about 6% before Friday's open as Nvidia, AMD and Nasdaq futures kept sliding.

items.t: Binance wins a $6.5 billion worldwide freezing order over its October hack
items.x: An Abu Dhabi court gave Binance a $6.5 billion worldwide freezing order against the unknown hackers behind the October 29 attack; 26,000 wallets are listed.

items.t: CFTC chair says Hyperliquid can enter the US by registering or partnering with an exchange
items.x: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said onchain derivatives venues like Hyperliquid can serve US retail traders if they register as an exchange or team up with one.

items.t: Gold falls to $3,540, a 14-month low, and heads for a 9% weekly loss
items.x: Spot gold dropped 2.3% to about $3,540 an ounce on November 20 and is set for its worst week since March; silver lost 6.6% as Fed hike bets lifted the dollar.

items.t: What's happening with Insmed (INSM)? Shares jump 21% on a report that Sanofi is weighing a takeover
items.x: Insmed closed up about 20.6% at $144.46 on November 19 after Bloomberg reported that Sanofi is exploring a bid for the roughly $26.6 billion lung-disease drugmaker. Neither company has confirmed talks.

items.t: What's happening with NetEase (9999)? Shares sink 19% after a weak games quarter
items.x: NetEase fell about 19% in Hong Kong on November 20, to around HK$152 — a 19-month low — after Q3 revenue of RMB 27.9 billion came in roughly 8% below forecasts and game sales shrank 2% year on year.

items.t: Asian stocks head for worst week since 2020 as the AI sell-off spreads
items.x: Japan's Nikkei and Korea's Kospi fell about 4.5% and Taiwan nearly 6% on November 20, as AI chip stocks extended Wall Street's slide after Anthropic's debut.

items.t: Bitcoin hits $61,000, a four-month low, as BlackRock's ETF sees record outflow
items.x: Bitcoin fell to about $61,270 on November 20, its lowest since July, after US spot ETFs lost $582 million in a day, led by a record exit from BlackRock's IBIT.

items.t: Intuit sells Mailchimp for $3.7 billion and shares fall on a soft outlook
items.x: Intuit agreed to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion, a third of what it paid in 2021. Revenue rose 12%, but weak guidance hit the stock after hours.

items.t: Market wrap Nov 19: S&P 500 −2% for a sixth straight loss, Bitcoin at $61.8K
items.x: Stocks fell 2% on Anthropic's debut day, gold hit a 14-month low and Bitcoin slipped to $61.8K with fear at 12/100. What moved and why.

items.t: Taiwan's market fell 6.6% in a day: the AI chip sell-off goes global
items.x: Taiwan's Taiex dropped 6.6%, Korea's Kospi 5.2% and the Nikkei 4.9% as the AI sell-off reached Asia. Why it spread, how far chip stocks are off their peaks and what $10 a day in TSMC did.

items.x: Bitcoin dropped to about $61,500, under the $62,862 it costs a big miner to produce one coin. Why it fell, what miners do next, and what daily buyers paid.

items.x: Anthropic (ANT) opened at $111.50 on Nasdaq, 34% above its $83 IPO price, touched $115.10, then slid toward $94 within about an hour. The numbers.

items.t: Dow drops 900 points as AMD sinks 9% on a short-seller's China report
items.x: US stocks reversed an early rally on November 19: the Dow fell about 900 points, while AMD dropped about 9% after Hunterbrook disclosed a short bet.

items.t: K3 Capital's sBOLD vault on Ethereum hacked for $3.4 million in 8 minutes
items.x: An attacker drained about $3.4 million from K3 Capital's sBOLD vault on Ethereum on November 19 via a share-pricing flaw; bots grabbed much of it.

items.t: SEC charges eight firms over fake crypto platforms that took $37 million
items.x: The SEC sued eight Colorado entities it says ran fake crypto trading platforms and chat groups that took over $37 million from US investors.

items.t: What's happening with Sky (SKY)? A 26% crash after a report on $518 million of illicit-linked flows
items.x: SKY, the token of the former MakerDAO, fell about 26% on November 19 to roughly $0.037 after Inca Digital said $518 million from hack- and sanction-linked wallets passed through Sky's stablecoin module. It is now more than 60% below its October peak.

items.t: What's happening with Williams-Sonoma (WSM)? Shares fall 13% as sales miss and the outlook stays put
items.x: Williams-Sonoma dropped about 13% on November 19 to roughly $225 after third-quarter revenue of $1.99 billion came in just under the $2 billion estimate and the company only reaffirmed its full-year forecast.

items.t: Binance hacker moves another $248 million in ether, the biggest transfer since the heist
items.x: Wallets tied to the record October 29 Binance hack moved about 137,600 ETH (≈$248M) on November 19, four times Tuesday's $63M transfer. What we know.

items.t: Nasdaq futures jump 2% ahead of Anthropic's debut as chip stocks rally
items.x: Nasdaq-100 futures rose about 2% before Anthropic's record $81 billion IPO started trading. Nvidia, Intel, AMD and Micron gained premarket. The numbers.

items.t: Walmart raises its yearly outlook for the third time; US online sales up 23%
items.x: Walmart beat estimates with $188.8 billion in quarterly revenue and lifted its full-year forecast again, but the outlook came in below what analysts hoped.

items.t: Best S&P 500 ETF in 2026: VOO, IVV, SPYM or SPY — fees from 0.02%
items.x: SPY, VOO, IVV and SPYM all track the S&P 500. The difference is the fee (0.02%–0.0945%) and where you live. A plain comparison, plus UCITS ETFs for Europe.

items.t: Ether falls below $1,800 as ETF outflows hit $2.4 billion and treasuries start selling
items.x: ETH slipped under $1,800 as US spot ether ETFs logged seven weeks of outflows and CoinShares sold its whole ether treasury. The numbers and the DCA view.

items.t: GTA 6 launches today, and Blockaid has flagged over 8,800 scam GTA tokens on Solana
items.x: As GTA VI goes on sale on November 19, security firm Blockaid counts 20,000+ GTA-named tokens on Solana, with 8,800+ flagged as malicious. What to watch for.

items.t: Polygon weighs a US banking license and plans $50–100 million payment-license deals
items.x: Polygon co-founder Sandeep Nailwal says it may seek a US bank charter and buy payment licenses in the EU, LatAm and Asia. POL is still 94% below its peak.
